**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 13:32
- [USER] The user is looking for advice on crafting a solid pitch for potential investors.
- [EVENT] The user has been attending a lot of networking events lately.
- [EVENT] The user met Sarah from Google at the Tech Expo conference last Thursday.
- [RELATIONSHIP] Sarah from Google is a person the user met and discussed potential collaboration opportunities with.
- [USER] The user wants to be prepared when following up with Sarah and others.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for crafting a solid pitch for potential investors, including defining the value proposition, knowing the target audience, developing a strong elevator pitch, preparing a structured pitch, using visual aids, practicing, and being prepared to answer questions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested that the user should follow up with Sarah by referencing their previous conversation, reiterating the value proposition, sharing updates, and expressing enthusiasm for potential collaboration.
- [USER] The user asked for examples of how to structure the introduction part of the pitch when reaching out to Sarah from Google.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided four examples of how to structure the introduction part of the pitch, focusing on building on the previous conversation, personalizing the connection, highlighting progress since the last meeting, and showing relevance to Google's focus areas.
- [USER] The user decided to go with the first example for the introduction of their pitch.
- [USER] The user requested feedback on their pitch deck, expressing uncertainty about including too much information and clarity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant expressed willingness to help review the pitch deck and provided criteria for feedback, including clarity, conciseness, relevance, visual appeal, and flow.
- [USER] The user described their pitch deck, stating it is for a platform that helps small businesses manage their online presence.
- [USER] The user mentioned the first slide is a title slide with the company name, logo, and tagline.
- [USER] The user stated the second slide is a problem statement slide describing challenges small businesses face in managing their online presence.
